testcase.name: times are written as floating local time with no trailing Z
the file name reflects the export scope
the uid is stable across exports so a re-import updates instead of duplicating
a locked segment is tagged and an unlocked one is not
a segment whose task is unknown is labelled rather than dropped
a plan-less export is still a well-formed empty calendar
a date filter exports only that day
a segment without an id still gets a deterministic uid
the task name becomes the summary and the span becomes the description
a backslash is escaped before the other escapes so it is not doubled
segments are exported in chronological order regardless of input order
semicolons, commas and newlines are escaped per RFC 5545
